scenes.name: 1-ready
scenes.title: Set it up in seconds
scenes.body: Pick the button, the spot and the speed, then press F6 anywhere.

scenes.name: 2-running
scenes.title: See every run's progress
scenes.body: A live count and a bar show how close it is to the limit you set.

scenes.name: 3-sequence
scenes.title: Click several spots in order
scenes.body: Mix clicks at points and key presses, each with its own wait, on a loop.

scenes.name: 4-profiles
scenes.title: A hotkey for each set-up
scenes.body: Save set-ups as profiles and start any of them with its own key.
